text_block_list.text:
The Tracen Academy annual summer training 
camp. Sakura Chiyono O was fired up from 
day one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely grow, and with my own 
running, I'll ignite the engine Maruzensky 
hasn't even used yet! Carrying that vow in 
her heart.
